title: Neon Cowboy King
description: A glowing blue cowboy figure wearing a golden crown and star badge stands holding a long staff in one hand and a large white cattle skull in the other. He is surrounded by floating banana peels, colorful confetti, musical notes, and glowing halos against a cracked cityscape background with horizontal lines.
prompt: A luminous ghostly blue cowboy wearing a golden crown and sheriff star stands in the center, holding a glowing staff and a large white longhorn cattle skull. Floating banana peels, musical notes, confetti and sparkles surround him. Cracked purple and white city buildings in the background with horizontal cyan lines across a pale yellow sky, surreal symbolic style with glowing outlines and painterly texture.
